brief:
Shehab Wire reports that Radaa, a force operating under resistance security in Gaza, directed a message to gang members seeking to defect and repent. The force stated that eliminating senior collaborators would serve as their path to reconciliation with resistance security agencies and their community.

The announcement targeted members of what the force describes as client gangs. Radaa framed the elimination of high-level collaborators as a condition for clemency, positioning such action as protective cover against both resistance security apparatus and public accountability.

The message represents an effort to incentivize defections among armed gang networks operating in Gaza.
